comparison: Matches law4-energy-v3 on 13/15 graded tasks (including img_bars4 4/4 hq=1.0000 at 0 Conv2d NS, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain, grid100, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x, both >500x Nash, zero_tanh_rail_escape) while maintaining 68.84 ms/step contended (~47.8 ms idle) and 1243.44 MiB (-129.2 MiB) on dcgan_performance_r256.
conclusion: law4-energy-v4 scores 13/15 graded PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1 (2 FAIL: grid100_mlp16 prec=0.9570 ctr=0.6775, vector_unequal_width cov_err=2.3160; 1 GPU-contention TIMEOUT: five_word_joint_smoke). Exact step-by-step parity profiling exposed the root cause: Law4EnergyV4Optimizer's fast 1D path omitted UnifiedV11's eps=1e-8 floor on hypot(g_norm, s_eff), causing a 3.3e-3 to 8.4e-3 bias jump on step 0 of 16-layer MLPs where early-layer bias grad_norm < 1e-8.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: law4-energy-v4 achieves 16/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1 (matching unified-v11 on every 2D/vector/DDGAN/Word/Nash/16-layer MLP task while achieving 4/4 hq=1.0000 on img_bars4 with 0 Conv2d NS).
next_action: Fix the 1D eps=1e-8 clamp (and verify exact <1e-6 2D MLP parity across depth=16 and vector_unequal_width) in law4-energy-v5, screen on r4-occam-ablation-v1 + dcgan_performance, then run full matched verification (t4-nash, t4-arch, discriminator_stability Tiers 1-2).
